ivr_prompts.welcome: Welcome to Poonawala Fincorp. This is VR, your dedicated loan advisor. I'm here to assist you with comprehensive financial solutions backed by decades of trust.
ivr_prompts.menu_intro: Please speak naturally or use the keypad for menu options.
ivr_prompts.name_request: May I have your name, please?
ivr_prompts.amount_request: What loan amount are you interested in?
ivr_prompts.purpose_request: Could you tell me the purpose of your loan requirement?
ivr_prompts.eligibility_check: I'll evaluate your profile against our lending standards. Please give me a moment.
ivr_prompts.success: Excellent news. Your profile qualifies for our loan products. I'm connecting you with our loan specialist for final processing.
ivr_prompts.not_eligible: Based on our current assessment, your profile doesn't meet our criteria at this time. We encourage you to reapply once your financial profile strengthens.
ivr_prompts.document_upload: To complete your application, I'll need to collect some documents. We can proceed now or arrange a convenient time.
ivr_prompts.confirmation: Your application has been received and is under our review. You will receive regular updates via WhatsApp.
ivr_prompts.handoff: I'm transferring you to our loan specialist team to finalize the details of your application.
